name: PHYSBE
description: A physiological simulation benchmark experiment that specifies reference scenarios and data for evaluating physiological simulation models.
evaluation_method: error-based metrics (RMSE, MAE) and qualitative/visual comparison of simulated vs reference traces
reputation: A longstanding, domain-specific reference benchmark in physiological simulation literature but relatively niche outside physiological-modeling research.
notes: Old/classical simulation benchmark (domain-specific); small and intended for model validation rather than ML benchmarking; not aimed at LLM evaluation.
